violation_type.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Regular Meals and Snacks (26 TAC §744.2401(a))
violation_type.short_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Regular Meals and Snacks
violation_type.typical_finding: It was determined that a child enrolled in the operation did not receive a scheduled lunch meal during a break camp day, despite being signed up for the lunch package.

finding_variants.text: It was determined that a child enrolled in the operation did not receive a scheduled lunch meal during a break camp day, despite being signed up for the lunch package.

The program s snack menu does not follow or meet the required meal pattern listed by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) that is administered by the Texas Department of Agriculture.
